title: Kalshi and Artnet partner to bring art market expertise to prediction markets
summary: Artnet is now Kalshi's official art partner, proposing art markets and supplying settlement data, starting with New York's November auctions.
body_markdown:
Kalshi, the world’s next-generation financial exchange, and Artnet, the leading source for art market data and intelligence, today announced Artnet as Kalshi’s official art partner. Launching ahead of New York’s November marquee auction week, the partnership will see Artnet provide the data used to settle Kalshi’s art markets.


Kalshi introduced


[art prediction markets in May 2026](https://news.kalshi.com/p/kalshi-art-markets-launch)


, allowing users to trade on the outcomes of auction sales, fairs, and other major art world events. On Kalshi, users trade yes-or-no contracts in a peer-to-peer structure on the outcome of future events. The partnership with Artnet builds on that offering, creating new ways for art enthusiasts, collectors, and market watchers to take part in the art market.


This partnership combines Kalshi’s prediction market platform with Artnet’s market intelligence and data. Artnet will propose market topics for Kalshi’s consideration, including the auctions, art fairs, and other art world events generating the greatest interest across the industry. For example, markets might ask whether a particular auction lot will exceed its high estimate or whether a major multimillion-dollar sale will occur at an art fair. Such moments that shape the art industry can now become opportunities for a broader audience to take part.


“The art world’s biggest moments have always sparked debate. With Kalshi, we’re bringing nearly four decades of Artnet data and expertise to more people and giving them a new way to join the conversation,” said Jeffrey Yin, chief executive officer, Artnet and Artsy.


“Partnering with Artnet couples Kalshi’s art markets with Artnet’s unparalleled curation expertise and four decades of trusted data. The art world has historically been reserved to an elite cohort, but this collaboration allows art enthusiasts of any kind to participate in the cultural zeitgeist in an entirely new way.” - Ian Cook, Markets team at Kalshi


Artnet will provide the data to confirm the outcome of these markets, drawing on its expertise and the Artnet Price Database, the leading resource for auction results. Kalshi designs the contracts, operates the exchange, and resolves markets under its regulatory framework.


The first markets are now live ahead of New York’s November marquee auctions and can be found on Kalshi at


[kalshi.com/category/culture/art](http://kalshi.com/category/culture/art)


. Miami Art Week in December will be the next major moment for the partnership.


### **About Artnet**


Artnet is the world’s most comprehensive platform for art market data, news, and transactions. The company gives collectors, galleries, dealers, and art market professionals around the globe access to the Artnet Price Database, Artnet News, Artnet Auctions, and the Artnet Gallery Network—tools and journalism that help people research, understand, buy, and sell art with confidence. Founded in 1989, Artnet is headquartered in New York City and London. Learn more at


[www.artnet.com](https://www.artnet.com/)


.


### **About Kalshi**


Founded in 2018, Kalshi is the world’s next-generation financial exchange. Prediction markets provide accurate, real-time information on the likelihood of events, making people more informed about the future. As the first regulated exchange for events, Kalshi is credited with legalizing and establishing prediction markets as a financial asset class. It’s the leading safe and regulated platform, trusted by millions of people and a growing number of institutions in America.
